entries.source: sql` WITH ranked AS ( SELECT ${nodeRuns.id} AS id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ${nodeRuns.id}) - COUNT(*) OVER () AS seq FROM ${nodeRuns} WHERE ${nodeRuns.taskId} = ${taskId} AND ${nodeRuns.seq} IS NULL ) UPDATE ${nodeRuns} SET "seq" = ranked.seq FROM ranked WHERE ${nodeRuns.id} = ranked.id AND ${nodeRuns.seq} IS NULL `
